def _xorshift32(r):
    r = r ^ (r << 13 & 0xFFFFFFFF)
    r = r ^ (r >> 17 & 0xFFFFFFFF)
    r = r ^ (r << 5 & 0xFFFFFFFF)
    return r & 0xFFFFFFFF
